# Freya.courses

> > Learn digital art and Procreate from professional illustrator Freya Kotchakorn with comprehensive courses, masterclasses, and professional brush sets.

Freya.courses is a digital art education platform with 80,000+ students offering Procreate courses ranging from beginner fundamentals to advanced professional illustration. The platform combines structured academy courses, specialized masterclasses, and professional-grade brush sets designed for realistic digital painting effects.

## Key Topics

- Procreate
- Digital Art
- Freya Kotchakorn
- Procreate Brushes
- Digital Illustration
- Portrait Drawing
- Painting Techniques
- Botanical Drawing
- Watercolor Brushes
- Oil Painting
- Procreate Masterclass
- Art Fundamentals
- iPad Digital Art
- Brush Sets
- Digital Painting

## Core Courses & Academy

- [Freya's Digital Art Academy](https://freya.courses/digital-art-academy): Structured digital art academy with 16+ courses covering multiple art techniques.
- [Procreate Masterclass 2.0](https://freya.courses/masterclass/procreate-masterclass-2-0): Advanced Procreate masterclass with digital illustration techniques and fundamentals.
- [Masterclass for Procreate - From Beginner to Pro](https://freya.courses/masterclass-for-procreate): Step-by-step Procreate masterclass taking beginners to professional illustrators.
- [Freya's Courses for Procreate](https://freya.courses/courses-for-procreate): Main course catalog featuring comprehensive Procreate courses for all skill levels.

## Specialized Art Masterclasses

- [Portrait Academy for Procreate: Draw Realistic Faces](https://freya.courses/portrait-academy-for-procreate): 20+ hour portrait course teaching facial proportions and realistic face drawing.
- [Children's Book Mastery with Procreate](https://freya.courses/children-book-mastery): Complete course on creating and publishing children's books using Procreate.
- [Digital Oil Painting in Procreate: Realistic Landscape](https://freya.courses/oil-landscape-in-procreate): Tutorial for painting realistic oil landscapes in Procreate with composition techniques.
- [Draw Realistic Pet Portraits in Procreate](https://freya.courses/pet-portraits-procreate): Guide to drawing realistic pet portraits with fur textures and animal movements.
- [Wild Flowers in Procreate](https://freya.courses/draw-flowers-in-procreate): Step-by-step botanical flower drawing tutorial with custom brushes and stamps.

## Professional Brush Sets

- [The Ultimate Watercolor Brush Set](https://freya.courses/watercolor-brush-set-for-procreate): 144 hyper-realistic watercolor brushes for Procreate with paper textures.
- [Oil Brush Set](https://freya.courses/oil-brush-set-for-procreate): 99 custom oil brushes for Procreate made from real canvas strokes.
- [The Impasto Brush Set](https://freya.courses/impasto-brush-set-for-procreate): 70 custom impasto brushes for Procreate with authentic oil painting effects.
- [Digital Makeup Brushset for Procreate](https://freya.courses/digital-makeup-brushset-for-procreate): 183 professional makeup brushes for Procreate portrait enhancement.
- [Effortless Flower Brush Set for Procreate](https://freya.courses/effortless-flower-brush-set-for-procreate): 131 custom Procreate flower brushes for quick botanical artwork creation.
- [Gouache Brush Set](https://freya.courses/gouache-brush-set-for-procreate): Procreate brush set for gouache painting with digital art tools.
- [Freya's Brush sets for Procreate](https://freya.courses/brushes-for-procreate): Product catalog of 10 professional Procreate brush sets with realistic effects.
